diagnostic_contract.ranking: Complete closed approval day; score descending then order_id ascending; floor(0.1*N) before outcome/group masks. Unknown outcomes consume slots.
diagnostic_contract.historical_outcome: Actual delivery strictly before the original fold evaluation-start cutoff; evaluation months remain inspected development retests.
diagnostic_contract.phase_scope: All12 original phases at every seed and contrast; repeated historical months stay separate. Only the three disjoint development months may be pooled within a seed.
diagnostic_contract.group_scope: ALL, every observed true route plus the fixed SP->SC focus even when empty, eight RPA marginals, eight disjoint R/P/A cells, five original age bins inside110; no subgroup reranking or quotas.
diagnostic_contract.missing: Missing age has A=false, along with other finite ages outside(24,72]; missing/empty does not imply a particular cause. Undefined rates stay null.
diagnostic_contract.counts: Every group retains fixed known/unknown/delayed denominators, four model TP/FP/FN/known-alert/unknown-alert/total-alert/recall/precision, and all four contrast recovered/lost/on-time/unknown exchanges.
diagnostic_contract.gross: Within-group=min(dropped,added), outgoing=max(dropped-added,0), incoming=max(added-dropped,0), first per complete day then summed. Route and cell partitions separately conserve daily changed slots; no causal donor-recipient pairing.
diagnostic_contract.statistics: Pair new minus old inside each seed, then report mean/min/max/span and negative/zero/positive/undefined counts; never subtract marginal extrema or treat five repetitions as independent orders.
diagnostic_contract.model_stability: For each colsample and each feature package, retain all five-seed model metric mean/min/max/span, especially TP and recall; a narrower age-minus101 gap does not imply each model became less variable.
diagnostic_contract.gap_stability: For age-minus101 at each colsample, retain paired TP/recall span and direction counts. Report span(1.0)-span(0.8) descriptively; positive mean or consistent negative signs alone is not stable improvement.
diagnostic_contract.did: Inside each seed and fixed group compute[(age10-base10)-(age08-base08)] for every model metric, then mean/min/max/span/sign counts. Rates require the same known/delayed denominator; any undefined operand yields null.

lost_sets.definition: Known delayed, alerted by that contrast own old version and missed by its own new version, at the same seed.
lost_sets.all_phases: ALL overlap across five seeds for every phase and four contrasts.
lost_sets.february_focus: ALL/R/P/A/RP/RA/PA/RPA, eight cells, five finer110 age bins, SP->SC route; all four contrasts.
lost_sets.statistics: Five set sizes, all-five intersection/union, multiplicity1..5, all ten unordered seed-pair intersection/union/Jaccard; empty union Jaccard null.
lost_sets.cross_colsample: Within each seed and February focus group compare newly-lost sets of age-minus101 at0.8 versus1.0; each keeps its own paired101 reference.
lost_sets.privacy: Only aggregate identity overlap counts are public, never order lists or identity hashes.

diagnostic_contract.compact_output: Public column definitions accompany numeric tables. Retain all groups and12 phases; omit individual order identities, daily detail and rank-transition matrices. Keep the aggregate JSON below50,000,000 bytes.
diagnostic_contract.frozen_reference: The0.8 score ledger, metrics, group counts and daily gross totals must reproduce the completed five-seed diagnostic before any1.0 result is summarized.
prohibitions: No model deserialization, fit, saved-model replay, calibration or model/seed selection in diagnosis
No best-seed choice, February-driven selection, subgroup quota or new original-holdout scoring
Original80-candidate primary and default RF unchanged; same historical/development data are not independent tests
colsample1.0 retains subsample0.8 and other randomness; no claim that sampling caused any prior loss

prespecified_stability.individual_models: Each colsample and feature package: five-seed mean/min/max/span, with same population.
prespecified_stability.age_gap: Within each seed age102 minus101: five-seed mean/min/max/span and negative/zero/positive/undefined counts.
prespecified_stability.span_change: Span at1.0 minus span at.8, for individual models and paired age gaps separately.
prespecified_stability.interpretation: Descriptive only; narrow gap does not imply a stable individual model, direction consistency does not imply improvement; no thresholds or winners.

policies.training: Eight identical deadline_wait0 mature monthly cohorts, all five fixed paired seeds and both frozen feature packages; exactly80 new1.0 fits including seed42.
policies.only_change: colsample_bytree .8 to1.0; subsample remains.8, L2=100, native topk10 and every other full classifier/ranker parameter unchanged.
policies.preprocessing: Unchanged train-only median/add_indicator and categorical imputer/OHE rules; same train values imply same deterministic statistics, checked from train and frozen dimensions/indicator names. No old model is loaded to inspect its statistics.
policies.frozen_reference: Old80 models are hashed, never deserialized or replayed. Old640560 score rows are checked against source metrics/alerts and preserved unchanged in the combined ledger.
policies.ranking: Full closed daily floor(.1*N), score DESC/ID ASC, unknown outcomes compete before original historical known-label masks.
policies.statistics: Every feature, colsample and difference-in-differences contrast is paired inside a seed before five-seed mean/min/max/direction counts. Only three disjoint development months pool inside each seed.
policies.selection: No seed, colsample, feature package or new historical candidate selection; previous primary/default unchanged.
policies.limitations: Already inspected historical/development data, not new independent tests; stable direction is not causal evidence about feature sampling.
policies.holdout: Original retained period remains unscored; no feature rows at or after2018-05-01.
policies.reuse: Only explicit same-spec own1.0 partial version reuse; actual fit and reload counts reported separately, never old.8 model reuse.
